overview_description.description:
Luciq is the first Agentic Mobile Observability Platform, purpose-built to help enterprise teams deliver flawless app experiences at scale. With intelligent AI agents acting on behalf of developers, Luciq optimizes stability, performance, and workflows across the entire mobile lifecycle so teams can fix nothing and build what matters.

The company was founded in 2014 and headquartered in California, United States.
